provenance_note: Verbatim campaign values. Raw benchmark-results run dirs for most qwen38-* studies were pruned from the fleet by 2026-09-25; every number here survives through tp4/promotion-evidence.md, tp4/qsa-selection-evidence.md, surviving deployments/*/profile.json verdict records on maxwell, or the two surviving raw HC component JSONs (qwen38-hc-20260916, qwen38-hc-striping-20260916). Rows cross-indexed into results.jsonl where serving-level.

variants.run_dir: qwen38-hc-20260916 (survives on maxwell; weight-sharding-rank0.json read directly)

summary.units: microseconds per operation, median (no tok/s in this component screen)
summary.notes: Synthetic cold-weight screen ('no serving speedup claim'): sharded CuTe+RoCE slower than replicated BLAS (rows=32 simt1 median 270.95µs vs 67.45µs); compute-only 24.6-28.2µs shows comms dominate — HC TP-shard ships only at TP4 for memory (HC_TP=1); TP2 must run replicated/off.

variants.run_dir: qwen38-hc-striping-20260916 (survives on maxwell; rank0.json + protocol.json read directly)

summary.units: microseconds per complete HC path, eager median (no tok/s in this component study)
summary.gate: required >=5% lower complete-path eager latency at 7520 and 8192 rows before serving integration
summary.notes: Every striped arm exceeded whole at all displayed row counts (e.g. 6768 rows: whole 3868µs vs pipeline2 4930µs) — striping gate unmet; correctness still passed (max relative RMSE vs whole 0.015, min cosine 0.999).
